posts.en:
dsh-browser is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-583cce0cd7543bfe47ed.html
